title: Busemann functions and equilibrium measures in last passage percolation models
key_contribution: Develops Busemann function approach for LPP with i.i.d. weights; connects to equilibrium measures of multi-class interacting fluid systems

title: Estimation of the last passage percolation constant in a charged complete directed acyclic graph via perfect simulation
venue: Latin American Journal of Probability and Mathematical Statistics
key_contribution: Constructs Max Growth System (MGS) particle system for LPP constant estimation; develops perfect simulation algorithm

title: Orthogonal polynomial ensembles in probability theory
key_contribution: Survey connecting LPP to random matrix eigenvalue distributions; discusses corner growth model and universal fluctuations

title: Optimal tail estimates in β-ensembles and applications to last passage percolation
key_contribution: Proves optimal moderate deviation estimates for Tracy-Widom tails; applies to exponential LPP fluctuations
